subject: 📅 Interview Invitation — $program_applied
body:
Dear $applicant_name,

Following the initial review of your application, the Admissions Committee would like to invite you to an interview as part of the selection process.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
INTERVIEW DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Application ID:   $application_id
Programme:        $program_applied
Date:             $interview_date
Time:             $interview_time
Format:           $interview_format
Location / Link:  $interview_location
Interviewer(s):   $interviewers
Duration:         $interview_duration minutes

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

HOW TO PREPARE

  • Re-read your personal statement and be ready to discuss it.
  • Bring (or have to hand) photo ID and any portfolio/work samples requested.
  • For online interviews, test your camera, microphone, and connection beforehand.
  • Aim to join 5 minutes early.

Please confirm your attendance by replying to this email by $confirm_by. If the time is not workable, let us know straight away and we will do our best to reschedule.

Good luck — we look forward to meeting you.

Kind regards,
University Admissions Office
